description: Add tax to a net (pre-tax) amount or remove tax from a gross (tax-inclusive) amount, given a rate. Pure formula, not a live VAT/sales-tax rate lookup.

amount.description: The amount to add tax to (net) or remove tax from (gross)

direction.description: "add" treats amount as net and computes gross; "remove" treats amount as gross and backs out net

ratePercent.description: Tax rate as a percent, e.g. 20

name: calculate_tax
